new_family_boundary.falsifiable_claim: After fresh RGB-only perception training, the learned K and O fields and their fixed hierarchical class adapter will improve the preregistered boundary objective, class metrics, and paired RGB sensitivity through the staged gates and reach the update-1000 perception thresholds.
new_family_boundary.hypothesis: The frozen V12 encoder-decoder learned substantial RGB-to-BEV signal but its direct three-class prototype objective left occupied recall materially deficient. A dense learned pair of signed boundary-distance fields supplies spatially graded error on both sides of known/unknown and free/occupied boundaries instead of treating every same-class cell as an interchangeable prototype target. This may make narrow occupied structures and their boundaries learnable without adding privileged model inputs, hand-authored inference geometry, predictor training, or new data.

predictor_boundary.reason_to_wait: This probe changes the state representation and must first show that learned RGB perception produces useful, balanced signed-boundary fields. Training dynamics before the representation qualifies would confound perception with prediction and could target a discarded state.

fixed_hierarchical_class_adapter.exact_target_argmax_semantics: For every cell whose K and, when known, O values equal their exact target fields, adapter argmax must equal raster_labels.u1, including minimum-magnitude adjacent-boundary UNKNOWN, FREE, and OCCUPIED cases and empty-opposite saturation cases. UNKNOWN O=0 remains masked for training but is used with its exact K target for this adapter semantic test.
fixed_hierarchical_class_adapter.nll: Supply the three stable log probabilities as model.online_state logits to the exact inherited observer. Its softmax is the identity in exact real arithmetic, subject only to ordinary float32 rounding; the inherited observer then gathers the target probability, clamps it to torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps, and applies negative log.
fixed_hierarchical_class_adapter.observer_compatibility: The exact inherited raster observer and V10 class-macro control retain their softmax/log_softmax calls. Applying those operations to these normalized stable log probabilities is an identity in exact real arithmetic with normal float32 rounding; no custom observer bypass is authorized.
fixed_hierarchical_class_adapter.prediction: argmax over the three stable log probabilities; an exact tie selects the first class in UNKNOWN,FREE,OCCUPIED order
fixed_hierarchical_class_adapter.scale_rationale: The smallest nonzero exact target magnitude occurs at an adjacent opposite-label boundary and is 0.5/8=1/16. Scale 16 maps that magnitude to unit signed evidence. Scale 4 is rejected because exact near-boundary FREE or OCCUPIED target fields can then argmax as UNKNOWN.

K_field.target: +magnitude for FREE or OCCUPIED cells and -magnitude for UNKNOWN cells

O_field.loss_mask: FREE union OCCUPIED only; UNKNOWN is completely excluded from O numerator, denominator, gradients, and availability
O_field.opposite_search: For a FREE cell search only in-raster OCCUPIED cells; for an OCCUPIED cell search only in-raster FREE cells. UNKNOWN never acts as an O-field distance source.
O_field.target: +magnitude for FREE cells, -magnitude for OCCUPIED cells, and exactly 0 for UNKNOWN cells

signed_boundary_distance_transform.arithmetic_rule: Compute the deterministic target in float64 from integer row and column differences, including sqrt and clipping, then cast the completed target tensor once to the model loss dtype on the model device. Source tests must bind exact synthetic expected values and tolerance before execution.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.boundary_rule: The 0.5-cell subtraction is a fixed half-cell correction to the center-distance EDT surrogate; adjacent opposite centers therefore produce magnitude 0.5/8, and center distances at least 8.5 cells saturate at 1.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.empty_opposite_set_rule: If A is empty, d(x,A)=positive infinity by definition and magnitude(x)=1 exactly.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.geometry_interpretation: This is an exact implementation of the preregistered half-cell-corrected center-EDT surrogate. It is not claimed to be the exact Euclidean distance between cell-square interfaces or to reconstruct subcell boundary geometry.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.grid_geometry: Each raster cell center is the point (row,column) on a unit-spaced Cartesian grid. The surrogate uses exact Euclidean L2 distances between in-raster cell centers only.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.nearest_source_tie_rule: Equal-distance nearest opposite cells produce the same scalar target and therefore are not broken for target construction. If an implementation emits a nearest-source witness for testing only, choose the smallest row then smallest column; that witness must not affect the target.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.opposite_distance: For cell x and the field-specific opposite-sign set A, d(x,A)=min_{a in A} sqrt((row_x-row_a)^2+(column_x-column_a)^2). No padding, out-of-raster source, geodesic path, connectivity rule, chamfer approximation, interpolation, or learned geometry participates.
signed_boundary_distance_transform.target_sign_tie_rule: Raster labels determine target sign exactly, so a distance tie cannot change sign. O values on UNKNOWN are fixed to zero only as a serialization witness and remain loss-masked.

per_training_row_channel_macro.K: Within each training raster row, form the mean pointwise K loss separately over present UNKNOWN cells and present known=(FREE union OCCUPIED) cells, then take the unweighted mean of those present sign-group means.
per_training_row_channel_macro.O: Within each training raster row, omit UNKNOWN completely; form the mean pointwise O loss separately over present FREE cells and present OCCUPIED cells, then take the unweighted mean of those present sign-group means.
per_training_row_channel_macro.field_rule: If at least one O sign group is present, row_boundary_loss=0.5*K_macro+0.5*O_macro. If neither FREE nor OCCUPIED is present, O is unavailable and row_boundary_loss=K_macro exactly.
per_training_row_channel_macro.microbatch_rule: Gradient accumulation must reproduce the arithmetic mean over the effective batch of 16 rows exactly; it may not average unequal-size microbatch means or pool class pixels across rows.
per_training_row_channel_macro.present_group_rule: A sign group with zero cells in that raster is absent from both numerator and denominator; no zero placeholder, epsilon count, cross-row pooling, or frequency weight is used.
per_training_row_channel_macro.row_rule: Take the unweighted arithmetic mean of row_boundary_loss across training rasters; current and next raster losses then receive exact equal weight 0.5 each.

training_objective.pointwise_formula: For absolute error a: 0.5*a^2 when a<delta, otherwise delta*(a-0.5*delta), with delta=1/8. The two branches agree at equality. This is PyTorch Huber, not the differently scaled SmoothL1 convention.
